admin.problemPresentations.title: API response presentation rules
admin.problemPresentations.description: Control toast and silent handling for each generated API endpoint response, including HTTP, ERR, and NET variants.
admin.problemPresentations.emptyDescript: Generate API toast rules from the checked-in OpenAPI contracts before configuring overrides.
admin.problemPresentations.error.request: API response presentation overrides could not be loaded.
admin.problemPresentations.error.updateF: The presentation rule could not be saved.
admin.problemPresentations.error.resetFa: The presentation rule could not be reset.
admin.problemPresentations.notice.update: Presentation rule saved. Frontend clients will refresh the override from the auth API.
admin.problemPresentations.notice.reset: Presentation rule reset to its generated default.
admin.problemPresentations.searchPlaceho: Path, method, status, code, or tag
admin.problemPresentations.dialog.title: Edit {{code}}
admin.problemPresentations.dialog.descri: The endpoint, response status, and RFC 9457 identity remain generated from OpenAPI. This tenant override changes frontend presentation only.
admin.problemPresentations.dialog.messag: Optional Russian message; falls back to English or the safe API detail
admin.problemPresentations.dialog.commen: Why this response differs from the generated default
admin.problemPresentations.dialog.resetD: This removes the tenant override and restores the checked-in generated default.
admin.problemPresentations.preview.silen: This rule is silent because the calling form or feature owns its inline error state.
